post.description:
Opens a tab for a walk-in without a phone or a QR scan. With nobody on it to
tap "Yes, ours", lines the waiter adds above the threshold are waived and logged.

Folds this tab into another: every round, line, request and guest phone moves to
the surviving tab, and this one is voided, empty. Nothing is edited or deleted, and
both tabs' event logs record it.

A waiter adds a round. It is accepted at once (no undo window), each line records
the waiter, and lines at or above the outlet's threshold ask the guest to confirm.

Moves a tab to a free table. If someone is already seated there the answer is
409 `table_occupied` naming that tab, so the app can offer to merge instead.

Prices a cart without placing it, using the same validation and snapshot code
as placing an order, so the cart screen never does money maths of its own.

confirms the table's tab.

The guest's answer to a staff-added line: "Yes, ours" or "Not ours". Neither
removes the line; "Not ours" raises an alert for a manager, who can void it.

Places a round. Every name, price, tax class and modifier is copied onto the
lines; safe to resend with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

Cancels a round within 60 seconds, before it is accepted. After that only a
manager can void, with a reason.

post.description: Brings a bumped ticket back to preparing, if nothing on it has been served yet.

Exchanges a table's QR token for a TabSession, joining the table's live
tab or opening one. Anonymous: the QR token is the credential. Scanning again
with a still-valid session for the same tab returns that session's expiry
instead of minting another.
